code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Identify the repeated color strip and the nonzero shape.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(grid[r]) ]
    # The strip is a rectangular band of rows with identical nonzero color sequence.
    seq = None; band = []
    for r in range(h):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        if vals and len(set(vals)) > 1:
            seq = vals; band.append(r)
    colors = seq
    # Locate the singleton-color shape, excluding strip rows.
    cells = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] and r not in band]
    shape_color = min(set(x[2] for x in cells), key=lambda c: sum(x[2]==c for x in cells))
    coords = [(r,c) for r,c,col in cells if col == shape_color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in coords); r1=max(r for r,c in coords); c0=min(c for r,c in coords); c1=max(c for r,c in coords)
    pattern={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in coords}
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # Anchor the matching color in the sequence at its original location.
    idx=colors.index(shape_color)
    start=r0-idx*(r1-r0+1)
    for i,color in enumerate(colors):
        for dr,dc in pattern:
            rr=start+i*(r1-r0+1)+dr; cc=c0+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=color
    return out
'''
